+                traced = inspect_trace(raw_path)
+                expected = reference["cases"][name]
+                same = (proc.returncode == expected["exit_code"] == 0 and
+                        isinstance(parsed, dict) and parsed == expected["facts"] and
+                        parsed.get("ok") is True)
+                cases[name] = {"status": "pass" if same else "fail",
+                               "exit_code": proc.returncode,
+                               "same_reference_facts": same,
+                               "syscall_events": traced["syscall_events"],
+                               "observed_threads": traced["observed_threads"],
+                               "process_or_thread_exits": traced["process_or_thread_exits"],
+                               "raw_trace_sha256": traced["sha256"],
+                               "raw_trace_bytes": traced["bytes"],
+                               "trace_private": True,
+                               "error": None if same else "actual Linux case observations differ from pinned reference"}
+                observed.update(traced["syscalls"])
+                errors.update(traced["syscall_errno"])
+                restarts.update(traced["internal_restarts"])
+            except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
+                # Do not expose an absolute operator path or command in a
+                # public aggregate: raw exception text stays local only.
+                cases[name] = {"status": "blocked", "error_class": type(exc).__name__,
+                               "trace_private": True}
+    summary = {"schema": 1, "suite": "a04-linux-host-ptrace-syscall-observation",
+               "kernel_guest_verified": False, "hepta_profile_verified": False,
+               "trace_scope": "numeric_syscalls_and_errno_only; paths/NSS/TLS/services NOT captured",
+               "source": "actual_ptrace_get_syscall_info_of_fixed_host_linux_ELF",
+               "ptrace_tracer_sha256": tracer_sha, "source_sha256": runner.digest(HERE / "ptrace_trace.c"),
+               "reference_sha256": runner.digest(HERE / "baselines/linux-debian13-x86_64.json"),
+               "rootfs_manifest_sha256": runner.digest(manifest_path),
+               "syscall_table_sha256": runner.digest(header),
+               "arch": "x86_64", "trace_private": True,
+               "cases": dict(sorted(cases.items())),
+               "counts": {state: sum(c["status"] == state for c in cases.values())
+                          for state in ("pass", "fail", "blocked")},
+               "aggregate_syscalls": [{"number": nr, "name": names.get(nr, f"unknown_{nr}"),
+                                       "count": count} for nr, count in sorted(observed.items())],
+               "aggregate_internal_restarts": [{"number": nr, "name": names.get(nr, f"unknown_{nr}"),
+                                                "internal_code": code, "count": count}
+                                               for (nr, code), count in sorted(restarts.items())],
+               "aggregate_syscall_errno": [{"number": nr, "name": names.get(nr, f"unknown_{nr}"),
+                                              "errno": error, "errno_name": errno.errorcode.get(error, "UNKNOWN"),
+                                              "count": count} for (nr, error), count in sorted(errors.items())]}
+    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    out.write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
+    out.chmod(0o600)
+    return summary
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    ap.add_argument("--reference", type=Path, required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--rootfs", type=Path, required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path, required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--private-trace-dir", type=Path, required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--syscall-header", type=Path,
+                    default=Path("/usr/include/x86_64-linux-gnu/asm/unistd_64.h"))

+hashed staged A04 rootfs, runs disposable TCG with no network/host disks/KVM,
+retains actual serial/raw exit and compares ABI observations. Missing inputs,
+missing QEMU, hash drift or timeout are blockers, never successful guest tests.

+import argparse
+import gzip
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys

+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+ROOT = HERE.parents[2]

+# Accepted A01 guest boot evidence: exact host QEMU binary, not just text from `-version`.
+A01_QEMU_SHA256 = "8a35ccba41582fc6c38b9df85fc9e35fa1d42f414d2d7d8090ee9b2f5e7c0854"

+# Unlike elf[] claims, a modified reference can silently shrink the test
+# denominator; a modified library manifest can alter runtime dependencies.
+# Upgrade these pins only after a new real Linux baseline is independently run.
+A04_REFERENCE_SHA256 = "ea38aa903ead1f72683ab10dcefeb756ec8b1e115dfccf49d8a9823c8a968026"
+A04_ROOTFS_MANIFEST_SHA256 = "55aa8369d4f912267139ef7626c752814d7dc833e49accc337529f2545fb94cb"
+A04_ROOTFS_TAR_SHA256 = "df8df2e3cdcd308ef62a59268a4519e2923c9ff78145e46f26a4092725e80797"
+A04_ROOTFS_FILE_COUNT = 17
+A04_C_ELF_CASE_COUNT = 28
+A04_UNPORTED_CASE_COUNT = 4
+
+
+def imported(name, path):
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+

+differential = imported("a04_qemu_differential", ROOT / "compat/linux/compare.py")

+def load_fixed_reference(reference_path, rootfs_manifest_path):
+    """Reject a narrowed Linux reference or changed rootfs before guest replay.
+
+    The user must have supplied the reviewed A04 bytes, not merely two files
+    that agree with each other after being changed together.
+    """
+    if guest.sha_file(reference_path) != A04_REFERENCE_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("pinned A04 Linux reference SHA-256 mismatch")
+    if guest.sha_file(rootfs_manifest_path) != A04_ROOTFS_MANIFEST_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("pinned A04 rootfs manifest SHA-256 mismatch")

+    if (len(elf_cases) != A04_C_ELF_CASE_COUNT or

+    is the single-command A00 runner handoff. Archive extraction is confined
+    to this NEW private evidence directory and verifies each member's digest,
+    type and mode before any of its ELF bytes enter the guest image.
+    This checks INPUT identity only; it is not a guest execution claim.
+    """

+    archive = getattr(args, "rootfs_tar", None)

+    if guest.sha_file(Path(qemu).resolve()) != A01_QEMU_SHA256:

+    """Qualify only packaged, pinned C ELF cases; never upgrade incomplete W1.
+
+    A guest exit=33 plus self-reported ok is not enough: require that every
+    packaged case matches the *independent* Linux reference and that the
+    differential reports no unexpected blocked or altered ELF. The unported
+    host Python/Tokio cases must remain explicitly incomplete.
+    """
+    expected = {name for name, _, _ in guest.reference_elf_cases(reference)}

+            len(reference.get("cases", {})) != A04_C_ELF_CASE_COUNT + A04_UNPORTED_CASE_COUNT or
+            set(reference.get("binaries", {})) != set(guest.BINARY_FOR) or
+            set(listed) != expected or len(listed) != len(expected)):

+                "reason": "inconsistent or incomplete packaged case list"}

+    actual = guest_result.get("cases", {})
+    identical = all(actual.get(name, {}).get("status") == "pass" and
+                    actual[name].get("exit_code") == reference["cases"][name]["exit_code"] and
+                    actual[name].get("facts") == reference["cases"][name]["facts"]
+                    for name in expected)
+    allowed_blocked = all(
+        item.get("case") in reference["cases"] and item.get("case") not in expected and
+        item.get("reason") in ("candidate not run", "Linux reference did not run/pass")
+        for item in diff.get("blocked", []))

+                  guest_result.get("guest_execution_verified") is True and
+                  guest_result.get("guest_compatibility_passed") is True and
+                  identical and expected == matched and
+                  not diff.get("differences") and allowed_blocked)

+            "matched": len(expected & matched),

+
+def write_json(path, object_):
+    if path.exists():
+        raise ValueError("refusing to overwrite evidence: " + path.name)

+

+    test invocations on the same contract.

+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("cannot load workload catalog")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    try:

+    except module.CatalogError as exc:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"invalid workload catalog: {exc}") from exc
+    # Reports may be published as evidence; avoid embedding local absolute
+    # paths while retaining both input digests and coverage counts.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Run the pinned C ELF cases on host Linux with captured loader/libs.
+
+NO chroot, guest, QEMU or storage isolation is claimed. All filesystem writes
+stay in a throwaway scratch; system glibc loader may still resolve implicit host
+services, NSS and TLS. Hepta requires its own real trace.
+"""
+import argparse
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import platform
+import tempfile
+import sys
+
+HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+ROOT=HERE.parents[2]
+
+def load(name,path):
+    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,path)
+    obj=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(obj)
+    return obj
+
+runner=load("a04_run",HERE/"run.py")
+guest=load("a04_guest",HERE/"guest.py")
+capture=load("a04_capture",ROOT/"support/rootfs/capture.py")
+
+
+def run(root,manifest_path,reference):
+    root=root.resolve()
+    manifest_path=manifest_path.resolve()
+    capture.verify(root,manifest_path)
+    manifest=json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
+    binaries={x["name"]:x for x in manifest["elf"]}
+    lib_path=str(root/"lib/x86_64-linux-gnu")
+    env=os.environ.copy()
+    for name in ("LD_PRELOAD", "LD_AUDIT", "LD_DEBUG", "LD_ORIGIN_PATH"):
+        env.pop(name,None)
+    env.update({"LC_ALL":"C","TZ":"UTC","LD_LIBRARY_PATH":lib_path})
+    cases={}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="a04-staged-rootfs-") as td:
+        scratch=Path(td)
+        for name,stem,case in guest.reference_elf_cases(reference):
+            elf=binaries[guest.BINARY_FOR[stem]]
+            stage=root/elf["path"].lstrip("/")
+            actual_sha=runner.digest(stage)
+            if actual_sha!=reference["binaries"][stem]["sha256"] or actual_sha!=elf["sha256"]:
+                raise ValueError("rootfs ELF SHA mismatch: "+name)
+            interpreter=reference["binaries"][stem]["interpreter"]
+            if interpreter:
+                loader=root/interpreter.lstrip("/")
+                if not loader.is_file():
+                    raise FileNotFoundError("missing staged loader: "+interpreter)
+                command=[loader,"--library-path",lib_path,stage]
+            else:
+                command=[stage]
+            case_dir=scratch/name
+            case_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
+            command.extend([case_dir] if stem.startswith("sqlite_") else [case,case_dir])
+            cases[name]=runner.run_case(name,command,case_dir,env=env)
+    counts={state:sum(x["status"]==state for x in cases.values())
+            for state in ("pass","fail","not_run")}
+    return {"schema":1,"suite":"a04-host-staged-loader-elf-only",
+            "platform":{"system":platform.system(),"machine":platform.machine(),
+                        "release":platform.release(),"execution":"host_linux_no_chroot"},
+            "binaries":reference["binaries"],"cases":dict(sorted(cases.items())),
+            "counts":counts,"rootfs_manifest_sha256":runner.digest(manifest_path),
+            "staged_glibc_lib_path":"/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu",
+            "guest_execution_verified":False,
+            "all_staged_elf_passed":counts["pass"]==len(cases) and counts["fail"]==0}
+
+
+def main():
+    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    ap.add_argument("--rootfs",type=Path,required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--manifest",type=Path,required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--reference",type=Path,required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--output",type=Path,required=True)
+    args=ap.parse_args()
+    try:
+        result=run(args.rootfs,args.manifest,json.loads(args.reference.read_text()))
+    except (OSError,ValueError,RuntimeError,KeyError) as e:
+        ap.exit(2,"invalid staged rootfs/input: "+str(e)+"\n")
+    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n")
+    print(json.dumps({"counts":result["counts"],
+                      "all_staged_elf_passed":result["all_staged_elf_passed"],
+                      "guest_execution_verified":False}))
+    return 0 if result["all_staged_elf_passed"] else 1
+
+
+if __name__=="__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+            return chroot.run(archive, manifest, reference)
+        except OSError as exc:
+            if exc.errno in (errno.EPERM, errno.EINVAL):
+                self.skipTest(f"host uid 65534 mapping/chroot policy unavailable: {exc}")
+            raise

+    def make_input(self, base, *, noisy_stderr=False):
+        stage = base/'staged'
+        binary = stage/'usr/local/bin/a04/probe_static'
+        binary.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        source = base/'synthetic.c'
+        body = ('#include <stdio.h>\nint main(void) { '
+                + ('fputs("unexpected loader warning\\n", stderr); ' if noisy_stderr else '')
+                + 'puts("{\\"ok\\":true,\\"token\\":\\"chroot_exec\\"}"); return 0; }\n')
+        source.write_text(body)
+        subprocess.run(['gcc','-O2','-static',str(source),'-o',str(binary)],
+                       capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=30)
+        binary.chmod(0o555)
+        sha = chroot.capture.sha(binary)
+        manifest = base/'manifest.json'
+        manifest.write_text(json.dumps({'files': [{'path':'/usr/local/bin/a04/probe_static',
+                        'sha256':sha, 'bytes':binary.stat().st_size, 'mode':'0555'}],
+                        'elf':[{'name':'probe_static','sha256':sha,'path':'/usr/local/bin/a04/probe_static',
+                                'interpreter': None, 'needed': []}]}))
+        tar = base/'stage.tar'
+        chroot.capture.create_tar(stage, tar)
+        reference = {'binaries':{'static':{'sha256':sha,'interpreter':None,'needed':[]}},
+                     'cases':{'static.errno':{'status':'pass','exit_code':0,
+                                              'facts':{'ok':True,'token':'chroot_exec'}}}}
+        return tar, manifest, reference
+
+    def test_real_unprivileged_exec_in_pinned_rootfs(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
+            archive, manifest, reference = self.make_input(Path(td))
+            report = self.run_or_skip_host_policy(archive,manifest,reference)
+            self.assertEqual(report['counts'],{'pass':1,'fail':0,'not_run':0})
+            self.assertEqual(report['cases']['static.errno']['facts'],reference['cases']['static.errno']['facts'])
+            self.assertEqual(report['platform']['execution'],'host_linux_chroot_uid65534')
+            self.assertFalse(report['kernel_guest_verified'])
+            self.assertFalse(report['real_hepta_w1_verified'])
+            self.assertEqual(chroot.capture.sha(archive),report['rootfs_tar_sha256'])

+            report = self.run_or_skip_host_policy(archive, manifest, reference)
+            self.assertEqual(report['counts'], {'pass': 0, 'fail': 1, 'not_run': 0})
+            self.assertEqual(report['cases']['static.errno']['error'], 'unexpected_stderr')

+            self.assertEqual(report['counts'],{'pass':0,'fail':1,'not_run':0})

+        # Rebuild with different optimization flags: exact same JSON behavior,
+        # different executable SHA. files[] is updated while elf[] and the
+        # fixed reference retain the original identity (a real old false pass).
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:

+            staged.chmod(0o555)
+            source = json.loads(manifest.read_text())
+            source['files'][0]['sha256'] = chroot.capture.sha(staged)
+            source['files'][0]['bytes'] = staged.stat().st_size
+            self.assertNotEqual(source['files'][0]['sha256'],
+                                reference['binaries']['static']['sha256'])
+            manifest.write_text(json.dumps(source))
+            chroot.capture.create_tar(base/'staged', archive)
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'ELF bytes not identical'):

+                          'timed_out': False, 'cleanup_incomplete': False}

+        # Real host process group test. No chroot and no production side effects.
+        # A descendant inherits PIPE fds so killing only the parent would hang.
+        code = ("import subprocess,sys,time;"
+                "subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-c','import time; time.sleep(30)']);"
+                "print('spawned',flush=True);time.sleep(30)")

+                                    timeout=1, preexec_fn=None)

+        self.assertNotEqual(result['exit_code'], 0)
+        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - start, 5.0)
+        self.assertFalse(result['cleanup_incomplete'])
+
+    def test_detached_child_pipe_cannot_hang_host_executor(self):
+        # A grandchild deliberately escapes killpg via setsid while holding
+        # stdout open. It is tracked by PID and explicitly killed in finally.
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
+            pidfile = Path(td) / 'detached.pid'
+            child = ('import os,sys,time;os.setsid();'
+                     'open(sys.argv[1],"w").write(str(os.getpid()));time.sleep(30)')
+            parent = ('import subprocess,sys,time;'
+                      'subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,"-c",sys.argv[2],sys.argv[1]]);'
+                      'time.sleep(30)')
+            start = time.monotonic()
+            try:
+                result = chroot.bounded_run([sys.executable, '-c', parent,
+                                             str(pidfile), child], env=os.environ.copy(),
+                                            timeout=3, preexec_fn=None)
+                self.assertTrue(result['timed_out'])
+                self.assertTrue(result['cleanup_incomplete'])
+                self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - start, 9.5)
+            finally:
+                if pidfile.exists():
+                    try:
+                        os.kill(int(pidfile.read_text()), signal.SIGKILL)
+                    except ProcessLookupError:
+                        pass
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()

+

+ROOT = HERE.parents[2]

+
+def digest(path):
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+class FrozenPtraceProvenance(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_real_numeric_trace_inputs_and_current_elf_scope(self):
+        reference_file = HERE/'baselines/linux-debian13-x86_64.json'
+        manifest_file = ROOT/'support/rootfs/manifest-debian13-x86_64.json'
+        tracer = HERE/'ptrace_trace.c'
+        trace = json.loads((HERE/'baselines/linux-debian13-x86_64-ptrace.json').read_text())
+        reference = json.loads(reference_file.read_text())
+        self.assertEqual(trace['reference_sha256'], digest(reference_file))
+        self.assertEqual(trace['rootfs_manifest_sha256'], digest(manifest_file))
+        self.assertEqual(trace['source_sha256'], digest(tracer))
+        self.assertFalse(trace['kernel_guest_verified'])
+        self.assertFalse(trace['hepta_profile_verified'])
+        self.assertTrue(trace['trace_private'])
+        expected = {name for name in reference['cases']
+                    if name.startswith(('dynamic.', 'static.', 'sqlite_dynamic.', 'sqlite_static.'))}
+        self.assertEqual(set(trace['cases']), expected)

+        for entry in trace['cases'].values():
+            self.assertEqual(entry['status'], 'pass')

+"""A04 rootfs tar regression tests; host-only, never kernel qualification."""
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import tarfile
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('a04_rootfs_capture', ROOT/'support/rootfs/capture.py')
+capture = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+spec.loader.exec_module(capture)
+
+
+class RootfsArchive(unittest.TestCase):
+    def make_staged(self, base):
+        root = base/'staged'
+        (root/'etc').mkdir(parents=True)
+        (root/'usr/local/bin/a04').mkdir(parents=True)
+        for name, data, mode in [('etc/hosts', b'127.0.0.1 localhost\n', 0o444),
+                                 ('usr/local/bin/a04/probe', b'ELF-candidate', 0o555)]:
+            file = root/name
+            file.write_bytes(data)
+            file.chmod(mode)
+        manifest = base/'manifest.json'
+        manifest.write_text(json.dumps({'files': [
+            {'path': '/' + p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
+             'sha256': capture.sha(p), 'bytes': p.stat().st_size, 'mode': f'{p.stat().st_mode & 0o777:04o}'}
+            for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]}))
+        return root, manifest
+
+    def test_real_directory_type_and_roundtrip_extract(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
+            base = Path(td)
+            root, manifest = self.make_staged(base)
+            self.assertEqual(capture.verify(root, manifest), 2)
+            tarpath = base/'rootfs.tar'
+            capture.create_tar(root, tarpath)
+            original_digest = capture.sha(tarpath)
+            with tarfile.open(tarpath) as archive:
+                dirs = [member for member in archive if member.isdir()]
+                self.assertTrue(dirs)
+                self.assertTrue(all(member.type == tarfile.DIRTYPE for member in dirs))
+                self.assertTrue(all(member.size == 0 for member in dirs))
+            self.assertEqual(capture.extract_verified_tar(tarpath, manifest, base/'extracted'), 2)
+            self.assertEqual(capture.verify(base/'extracted', manifest), 2)
+            capture.create_tar(root, base/'again.tar')
+            self.assertEqual(capture.sha(base/'again.tar'), original_digest)
+
+    def test_symlink_escape_is_rejected(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
+            base=Path(td)
+            root, manifest=self.make_staged(base)
+            (root/'etc/outside').symlink_to('/etc/passwd')
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'unsafe rootfs'):
+                capture.verify(root, manifest)
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'unsupported staged'):
+                capture.create_tar(root, base/'bad.tar')
+
+    def test_duplicate_or_unsafe_manifest_rejected(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
+            base=Path(td)
+            root, manifest=self.make_staged(base)
+            obj=json.loads(manifest.read_text())
+            obj['files'].append(dict(obj['files'][0]))
+            manifest.write_text(json.dumps(obj))
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'duplicate'):
+                capture.verify(root, manifest)
+            obj['files'].pop()
+            obj['files'][0]['path']='/../../etc/passwd'
+            manifest.write_text(json.dumps(obj))
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'invalid'):
+                capture.verify(root, manifest)
+
+    def test_old_directory_as_file_is_reproducibly_broken(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
+            base=Path(td)
+            old=base/'old.tar'
+            with tarfile.open(old, 'w', format=tarfile.USTAR_FORMAT) as tar:
+                info=tarfile.TarInfo('etc/')  # defaults to REGTYPE, not DIRTYPE
+                self.assertEqual(info.type, tarfile.REGTYPE)
+                tar.addfile(info)
+                info=tarfile.TarInfo('etc/hosts')
+                tar.addfile(info)
+            with tarfile.open(old) as tar:
+                with self.assertRaises((NotADirectoryError, IsADirectoryError)):
+                    tar.extractall(base/'old-extract', filter='data')
+            _, manifest = self.make_staged(base)
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'link or special|directory|unsafe or duplicate'):
+                capture.extract_verified_tar(old, manifest, base/'old-rejected')
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()

+"""Real ORIGINAL Linux child regressions for strict reference collection.
+
+These are not Asterinas or Hepta results. Previously Python json.loads
+accepted duplicate keys/NaN and a valid stdout masked stderr diagnostics.
+"""
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("a04_reference_runner", HERE / "run.py")
+runner = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+spec.loader.exec_module(runner)
+
+
+class LinuxReferenceObservation(unittest.TestCase):
+    def actual_child(self, program):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="a04-reference-output-") as root:
+            return runner.run_case("probe", [sys.executable, "-c", program], Path(root))
+
+    def test_valid_single_line_and_zero_exit(self):
+        result = self.actual_child('print(\'{"ok":true,"errno":0}\')')
+        self.assertEqual(result, {"status": "pass", "exit_code": 0,
+                                  "facts": {"ok": True, "errno": 0}, "error": None})
+
+    def test_duplicate_success_key_not_accepted(self):
+        result = self.actual_child('print(\'{"ok":false,"ok":true}\')')
+        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "fail")
+        self.assertEqual(result["error"], "invalid stdout: ValueError")
+
+    def test_nonfinite_number_not_accepted(self):
+        result = self.actual_child('print(\'{"ok":true,"rate":NaN}\')')
+        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "fail")
+        self.assertEqual(result["error"], "invalid stdout: ValueError")
+
+    def test_stderr_warning_invalidates_matching_stdout(self):
+        program = 'import sys; sys.stderr.write("loader error\\n"); print(\'{"ok":true}\')'
+        result = self.actual_child(program)
+        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "fail")
+        self.assertEqual(result["error"], "unexpected stderr")
+        self.assertNotIn("loader error", str(result))
+
+    def test_extra_stdout_is_not_silently_ignored(self):
+        result = self.actual_child('print(\'{"ok":true}\'); print("unexpected line")')
+        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "fail")
+
+    def test_nonzero_exit_is_failure_even_with_correct_json(self):
+        result = self.actual_child('import sys; print(\'{"ok":true}\'); sys.exit(7)')
+        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "fail")
+        self.assertEqual(result["exit_code"], 7)
+        self.assertEqual(result["error"], "nonzero exit")
+
+    def test_rust_build_receipt_binds_lock_manifest_and_elf(self):
+        """A blocked Tokio runtime must retain the successful build identity."""
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="a04-rust-build-") as root:
+            binary_dir = Path(root)
+            build = SimpleNamespace(returncode=0, stderr="")
+            elf = {"sha256": "e" * 64, "size": 123, "interpreter": "/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2",
+                   "needed": ["libc.so.6"]}
+            runtime = {"status": "not_run", "reason": "host AF_UNIX policy"}
+            with patch.object(runner.shutil, "which", return_value="/usr/bin/cargo"), \
+                 patch.object(runner, "command", return_value=build) as command, \
+                 patch.object(runner, "inspect_elf", return_value=elf), \
+                 patch.object(runner, "run_case", return_value=runtime):
+                result = runner.run_rust("auto", binary_dir, binary_dir / "scratch", {})

+            self.assertEqual(result["build"]["binary"], elf)

+                             runner.digest(runner.HERE / "rust" / "Cargo.lock"))
+            self.assertEqual(command.call_args.args[0][1:4], ["build", "--offline", "--locked"])
